name: yt-video
description: a video made with the yt pipeline, idea to delivered film; every stage's check is yt's own evidence for it

stages.name: research
stages.exit: dossier.json written and `yt doctor` reports no fail for research

stages.name: styles
stages.exit: styles.json written and `yt doctor` reports no fail for styles

stages.name: script
stages.exit: script.json written and `yt doctor` reports no fail for script

stages.name: props
stages.exit: props.json written and `yt doctor` reports no fail for props

stages.name: voice
stages.exit: voice.json written and `yt doctor` reports no fail for voice

stages.name: retime
stages.exit: retime.json written and `yt doctor` reports no fail for retime; the screenplay carries the measured narration timings

stages.name: keyframe
stages.exit: keyframe.json written and `yt doctor` reports no fail for keyframe; the operator approved the look (yt keyframe --approve)

stages.name: vfx
stages.exit: vfx.json written and `yt doctor` reports no fail for vfx

stages.name: sound
stages.exit: sound.json written and `yt doctor` reports no fail for sound

stages.name: build
stages.exit: scene.xml written and `yt doctor` reports no fail for build

stages.name: render
stages.exit: video.mp4 written and `yt doctor` reports no fail for render

stages.name: deliver
stages.exit: a clean final render of the whole programme, the delivery gate deliverable and a QA pass at READY TO PUBLISH, both after that render

gates.name: script
gates.message: the owner has not approved the screenplay; nothing is recorded or animated before they do

gates.name: final
gates.message: the owner has not approved the final cut
